name: ariadne
author: @Lavender-exe
description: Webshell agent for PHP, ASPX, ASHX, JSP, JSPX, and Go with SOCKS5 tunneling and P2P.
features: PHP, ASPX, ASHX, JSP, JSPX, Go webshell templates
Deformed base64 encoding with per-deployment unique alphabet
Request template injection (form, JSON, image data, SOAP XML)
SOCKS5 proxy tunneling through the webshell
P2P agent linking (HTTP, SMB named pipes, TCP sockets)
Active beacon mode with configurable interval and jitter
